entries.claim_text: How much do language models memorize?
entries.quoted_snippet: How much do language models memorize?

entries.claim_text: arXiv preprint (2505.24832v3, cs.CL)
John X. Morris, Chawin Sitawarin, Chuan Guo, Narine Kokhlikyan, G. Edward Suh, Alexander M. Rush, Kamalika Chaudhuri, Saeed Mahloujifar
entries.quoted_snippet: John X. Morris

entries.claim_text: paper

Official code: unknown — the paper only describes an in-house training setup (models trained from scratch on a single A100 in bfloat16) and links no code repository, so no official release could be located.
entries.quoted_snippet: All models are trained on a single A100 GPU in bfloat16 precision, and we use gradient accumulation if a batch cannot fit in memory.

entries.quoted_snippet: Capacity in bits-per-parameter for models trained on synthetic data

entries.claim_text: 文字 unintended memorization 相對 oracle 先升後降 （evidence: .loop-manager/paper-cache/lm-memorization/evidence/fig_text_oracle_mem.tex）
entries.quoted_snippet: All quantities are calculated with respect to a large oracle

entries.claim_text: 在合成 bitstring 實驗上，double descent 尖峰落在 dataset-to-capacity ratio 等於 1（此圖為合成資料，非文字）（evidence: .loop-manager/paper-cache/lm-memorization/evidence/fig_double_descent.tex）
entries.quoted_snippet: double descent occurs exactly when the dataset size begins to exceed

entries.claim_text: membership inference scaling law 熱圖與實測 （evidence: .loop-manager/paper-cache/lm-memorization/evidence/fig_mi_scaling_law.tex）
entries.quoted_snippet: Scaling law curves for membership inference overlaid with empirical data

entries.claim_text: 記憶量與 TF-IDF 的相關：罕見詞樣本最被記住 （evidence: .loop-manager/paper-cache/lm-memorization/evidence/fig_tfidf_memorization.tex）
entries.quoted_snippet: The training documents with rarest words are typically the most memorized

entries.claim_text: 文字 train/test loss 的 double descent：test loss 尖峰隨參數量右移，19.2M 約在 6e4 樣本 （evidence: .loop-manager/paper-cache/lm-memorization/evidence/fig_text_train_val_loss.tex）
entries.quoted_snippet: Train and test losses of different model and dataset sizes trained on text. Double descent occurs when dataset size exceeds model capacity.

entries.claim_text: 8/16/32-token 前綴的 train 與 test extraction rate 在大資料集下趨同 （evidence: .loop-manager/paper-cache/lm-memorization/evidence/fig_text_extraction_rates.tex）
entries.quoted_snippet: Extraction rates of 64-token training sequences across prefix lengths, for both train and evaluation.

entries.claim_text: membership inference F1 隨資料量呈 sigmoid 由 1.0 衰減至 0.5，容量越大下墜點越右 （evidence: .loop-manager/paper-cache/lm-memorization/evidence/fig_membership_f1_curves.tex）
entries.quoted_snippet: Membership inference F1 across dataset sizes. In this case, F1 score of 0.5 implies random guessing.

entries.claim_text: membership vs extraction 呈 L 形：extraction=0 時 F1 仍可達約 0.93 （evidence: .loop-manager/paper-cache/lm-memorization/evidence/fig_membership_vs_extraction.tex）
entries.quoted_snippet: Membership inference vs 32-token-prefix suffix extraction rate. Membership inference is generally easier than extraction.

entries.claim_text: 20M 模型過容量後，TF-IDF 最高的前 20 筆全為非英語文本，index 0 記憶量 2.98 bits （evidence: .loop-manager/paper-cache/lm-memorization/evidence/fig_table03_examples.tex）
entries.quoted_snippet: Highest TF-IDF training examples from a $20M$ param model trained past its capacity

entries.claim_text: 這兩條主流路線確實無法區分「記住某筆資料」與「學會某種規律」
entries.quoted_snippet: the fact that a model outputs something is not necessarily a sign of memorization

entries.quoted_snippet: standard loss-based membership inference

entries.quoted_snippet: only ever measuring a lower bound on model capacity

entries.claim_text: 能多大程度用來推論模型對**自然文字**記住了多少，仍是開放的
entries.quoted_snippet: do not necessarily generalize to other datasets, architectures, or training setups

entries.claim_text: membership F1 可達 0.97 而 extraction rate 為 0 的情形
entries.quoted_snippet: membership inference is strictly higher in every case

entries.claim_text: 整個方法依賴對模型 likelihood 的存取
entries.quoted_snippet: estimate $H^K(x \mid \hat{\theta})$ by the negative log likelihood

entries.claim_text: scaling law 雖驗證到 1.5B 參數，但現代前沿模型大上兩三個數量級
entries.quoted_snippet: ranging from $500K$ to $1.5B$ parameters

entries.claim_text: 當 $|\mathcal{D}| \to \infty$ 時 attack 表現趨近 0.5，因而對訓練在無窮大資料上的模型，membership inference 與 extraction 都變得不可能
entries.quoted_snippet: as $|\mathcal{D}| \rightarrow \infty$, performance of our membership inference attack decreases to $0.5$

entries.claim_text: sigmoid 內部趨近 $c_2 c_3 = (-0.034)\times(-33.14) \approx 1.13$，$\sigma(1.13)\approx 0.755$，代回得 $F_1 \approx \tfrac{1}{2}(1 + 1.34\times0.755) \approx 1.01$，而不是 0.5
entries.quoted_snippet: Solutions found are $c_1 = 1.34$, $c_2=-0.034$, and $-33.14$
